docs.title: OSC-EM Schemas
docs.text:
Schemas for the Open Standards Community for Electron Microscopy (OSC-EM)

URI: https://w3id.org/oscem-schemas

docs.title: Available Schemas
docs.text: Schema Description General The general schema covering materials science and other use cases. SPA The single particle analysis focused schema. Subtomogram Averaging The molecular focused tomography schema, mainly for subtomogram averaging. Environmental Tomography A schema for environmental samples, more flexible sample descriptions. Cellular Tomography Schema for cellular or tissue samples, also with flexible sample descriptions.

docs.text:
Schema for the Open Standards Community for Electron Microscopy (OSC-EM)

URI: https://w3id.org/oscem-schemas/latest/env_tomo

Name: EnvironmentalTomography

docs.title: Classes
docs.text: Class Description Acquisition General acquisition covering materials science and other use cases AcquisitionSpa AcquisitionTomo AcquisitionCelTomo AcquisitionEnvTomo AcquisitionSubTomo Any Any type, used as the base for type-narrowing BoundingBox2D an axis-aligned 2D bounding box (float units) ChromaticAberrationCorrector Special device used to correct instrument inherent chromatic aberration Descriptor List of custom descriptors for user-defined key-value pairs describing how mi... Descriptors Detector Class representing a detector EMDatasetBase OSC-EM Metadata for a dataset EMDatasetEnv Cryo electron tomography dataset of an environmental sample EnergyFilter A device used to filter for electrons with specific energy Freezing how the sample was frozen Funder Description of the project funding Grant Grant ImageSize size of a 2D image (in integer units) Instrument Instrument values, mostly constant across a data collection Microscope Microscope information Organizational Overarching category for authors and grants Person personal information Author Details on the person performing the experiment Phaseplate Used to modulate the phase of the electron wave QuantityValue if a value has a unit, it should be given as a unit value pair QuantitySI unit value extended to have two additional fields si_value and si_unit Range A range constructed from min and max Series A series of numbers constructed from min, max, and increment TiltAngle The min, max and increment of the tilt angle in a tomography session SampleEnv Unifying class to describe the full sample SpecialistOptics Optional optics used to correct for instrument limitations SpecimenEnv base information on the acquisition and treatment of the sample itself SphericalAberrationCorrector Special device used to correct instrument inherent spherical aberration Thinning how the frozen sample was thinned by i TomogramFeatures what was the target of the tomograms, and what area of a cell do they cover

docs.title: Slots
docs.text: Slot Description acceleration_voltage Voltage used for the electron acceleration, in kV acquisition atmosphere What was the atmosphere the sample was in right before freezing, elaborate on... authors List of authors associated with the project beam_convergence Refers to how tightly or widely the electron beam is focused onto the sample,... beamshift Movement of the beam above the sample for data collection purposes that does ... beamtilt Another way to move the beam above the sample for data collection purposes th... beamtiltgroups Number of Beamtilt groups present in this dataset - for optimized processing ... binning_camera Level of binning on the images applied during data collection blotting whether blotting was performed budget budget c2_aperture C2 aperture size used in data acquisition, in µm calibrated_defocus Machine estimated defocus, min and max values in µm calibrated_magnification Calculated magnification, no unit cellular_features What type of cellular features are present in your tomograms? chromatic_aberration_corrector Specialist device to correct for chromatic aberration of the microscope lense... collection_angle Collection angle set, min and max values in mrad collection_date When the sample was collected country Country of the institution cryogen Cryogen used in cooling the instrument and sample, usually nitrogen cryogen_sample_env the cryogen used to freeze the sample, i cs Spherical aberration of the instrument, in mm date_time Time and date of the data acquisition description The description of the item descriptor_name Name defining the descriptor descriptor_thing Description of the descriptor descriptors List of custom descriptors for user-defined key-value pairs describing how mo... details Any further comments on the freezing process go here details_tomo If you have any further comments on your tomograms please leave them here detectors dispersion Dispersion of an analytical detector, in eV dose_per_movie Average dose per image/movie/tilt - given in electrons per square Angstrom electron_source Type of electron source used in the microscope, such as FEG email email end_date end date energy_filter Whether an energy filter was used and its specifics exposure_time Time of data acquisition per movie/tilt - in s family_name last name frames_per_movie Number of frames that on average constitute a full movie, can be a bit hard t... freezing funder funding organization/person funder_name funding organization/person gainref_flip_rotate Whether and how you have to flip or rotate the gainref in order to align with... given_name first name grant_name name of the grant grants List of grants associated with the project grids_imaged Number of grids imaged for this project - here with qualifier during this dat... handling What was done to the sample, please give an overview of relevant treatments height The height of a given item - unit depends on item holder Speciman holder model holder_cryogen Type of cryogen used in the holder - if the holder is cooled seperately humidity_env humidity of the atmosphere right before/ during freezing; in % illumination Mode of illumination used during data collection image_size The size of the image in pixels, height and width given images_generated Number of images generated total for this data collection - might need a qual... imageshift Movement of the Beam below the image in order to shift the image on the detec... imaging Mode of imaging used during data collection increment Increment between elements of a series instrument instrument_thin Instrument used for thinning the sample instrument_type Details of a given specialist instrument ion_source what ion source was used? job_title job title lift_out whether a lift out was performed location the geographical location of your source, optimally in a geographic coordinat... main_target What was the main biological target of your research for this tomogram? manufacturer The name of the manufacturer maximal Maximal value of a given dataset property method freezing method - such as plunge freezing, high pressure freezing etc method_thin The thinning method used, such as FIB milling microscope Microscope information microscope_software Software used for instrument control, minimal Minimal value of a given dataset property mode Mode of the detector, e model The model of the item name The name of the item name_org Name of the organization nominal_defocus Target defocus set, min and max values in nm nominal_magnification Magnification level as indicated by the instrument, no unit operating_mode Operating mode of the microscope, i orcid ORCID of the author, a type of unique identifier organelles What organelles; if any; are present? organism the organism(s) present in your sample, if not perfectly defined try to asses... organizational person person phaseplate Phaseplate is a special optics device that can be used to enhance contrast pixel_size Pixel size, in Angstrom project_id project id role Role of the author, for example principal investigator sample screen_current The total electron beam current hitting the viewing screen, in nA source_env where is this sample from? i specialist_optics Any type of special optics, such as a phaseplate specimen_env spherical_aberration_corrector Specialist device to correct for spherical aberration of the microscope lense... start_date start date target_thickness What was the target thickness of the lamella; in nm technique Specifies which Acquisition subschema/class is in use docs.title: oscem-schemas-general
docs.text:
Schema for the Open Standards Community for Electron Microscopy (OSC-EM)

URI: https://w3id.org/oscem-schemas/latest/general

Name: General

docs.title: Classes
docs.text: Class Description Acquisition General acquisition covering materials science and other use cases AcquisitionSpa Any Any type, used as the base for type-narrowing BoundingBox2D an axis-aligned 2D bounding box (float units) ChromaticAberrationCorrector Special device used to correct instrument inherent chromatic aberration Descriptor List of custom descriptors for user-defined key-value pairs describing how mi... Descriptors Detector Class representing a detector EMDatasetBase OSC-EM Metadata for a dataset EMDatasetGeneral General dataset for TEM/STEM and EELS/EDX spectroscopy EnergyFilter A device used to filter for electrons with specific energy Funder Description of the project funding Grant Grant Grid Details on the grid used in the experiment ImageSize size of a 2D image (in integer units) Instrument Instrument values, mostly constant across a data collection Ligand Information on ligands if present Microscope Microscope information Molecule More detailed information about individual molecules Organizational Overarching category for authors and grants OverallMolecule Description of the overall molecule Person personal information Author Details on the person performing the experiment Phaseplate Used to modulate the phase of the electron wave QuantityValue if a value has a unit, it should be given as a unit value pair QuantitySI unit value extended to have two additional fields si_value and si_unit Range A range constructed from min and max Series A series of numbers constructed from min, max, and increment Sample Unifying class to describe the full sample SampleMolecular SpecialistOptics Optional optics used to correct for instrument limitations Specimen Description of specimen handling SphericalAberrationCorrector Special device used to correct instrument inherent spherical aberration

docs.title: Slots
docs.text: Slot Description acceleration_voltage Voltage used for the electron acceleration, in kV acquisition assembly What type of higher order structure your sample forms - if any authors List of
